title: Iceberg queries stuck in the planning phase for long time
body:
Our Iceberg queries are getting stuck in the planning phase for 2 to 3 minutes, although they eventually run successfully. We are currently upgrading Trino from version 444 to 454.  This issue has been occurring since Trino version 451 (we went back and tried different versions).

Our Iceberg stack -->
Storage: s3
File format: parquet
Catalog: Hive

Query explain: 

comments.body: @participant1 We tested Trino version 458, and while the planning time has improved, it remains unusually high, ranging between 30 to 50 seconds.
